name: aw-turnover-taxes
description: Aruba BBO, BAVP and BAZV turnover tax reference for businesses in 2026. Covers the combined rate components, an example on established taxable turnover, the sole-proprietor small-business threshold, threshold crossing, voluntary registration and the limited import-credit context. Includes a dated monthly filing and payment calendar reference. Use for Aruba turnover tax, small entrepreneur relief, BBO registration or import tax questions. It does not establish taxable turnover, place of supply, sector exemptions, reverse charge scope, customs valuation or complete import deduction eligibility. Indexed official sources require direct rechecking before release.
